big_case.notes: State of Louisiana and Cameron Parish emergency application to vacate a published Fifth Circuit stay order in high-dollar coastal-erosion litigation following Chevron USA Inc. v. Plaquemines Parish, raising an acknowledged circuit split over whether a post-transmittal 28 U.S.C. 1447(d) remand appeal triggers an automatic Griggs/Coinbase stay of state-court proceedings, but arising in an interlocutory stay posture with Justice Alito recused and days after the Court denied certiorari on the same question in City of Brunswick v. Honeywell.
